feature.name: Spend Balance API - Available Credit Event

scenario.name: AC02 - American Eagle cardholder at the collections boundary (pastDueAmount = <pastDueAmount>) still receives the available-credit email

step.name: Given a valid client "aeoutfitters" with an active account of type "PLCC" from channel "alerts-ui" With true and true
And the account has a past due amount of "0.00"
When the availableCredit event is submitted to the Alerts Spend Balance API
Then the API should respond with HTTP status 202
And an outbound event should be published with status "CONSUMED" followed by "PROCESSED"
And the outbound delivery status should be "SUCCESS" with reason code "SUCCESS_DELIVERED"
